plugins.name: context-forge
plugins.description: Session hygiene for long builds. HANDOFF compacts the session into a dated brief under .zcode/handoffs/ (goal, decisions with reasons, invariants, file map, current state, next steps, open questions) so a fresh session resumes without quality loss; CONVENTIONS merges code-derived project rules into AGENTS.md with file:line evidence; REFRESH updates an existing brief. Every claim carries a pointer; nothing is invented.
